搜尋所有章節的角色、台詞及備註: Search characters, dialogue and notes in all chapters
Tab 切換欄位 · Enter 下一行 · Shift+Enter 換行 ·: Tab: next cell · Enter: next row · Shift+Enter: line break · Double-click or type to edit · Blank character: narrator
輸入標籤（例如 color=#ff0000、w=0.5）: Enter a tag (e.g. color=#ff0000 or w=0.5)
未知角色 ID：請先新增角色。: Unknown character ID. Add the character first.
未知角色 ID：請先在「專案 → 角色管理」新增角色。: Unknown character ID. Add it in Characters first.
建立新專案：選擇工程文件保存位置: New project: choose a save location
選擇 Ren’Py game 資料夾（僅更新 adv_generated）: Choose the Ren’Py game folder (updates adv_generated only)
；匯出 Ren’Py 時會一起複製。: ; it will be included in Ren’Py exports.
未儲存的新專案：請按 ⌘S 選擇資料庫位置；之後每 5 秒自動儲存。: Unsaved project: press Cmd+S to choose a location. Autosaves every 5 seconds afterward.
貼上欄數超過目前位置的可編輯欄數: The pasted data exceeds the available editable columns.
完成本段台詞後 call 哪個段落？: Which section should be called after this section?
可修改代號、顯示名稱與顏色。儲存時檢查重名，並同步更新所有台詞的角色引用。: Edit IDs, names and colors. Saving checks for duplicate IDs and updates all dialogue references.
不能刪除使用中的角色。: Cannot delete a character that is in use.
不能刪除使用中的角色代號: Cannot remove a character ID that is in use.
例如 chapter01_opening；只能使用英數字與底線: e.g. chapter01_opening; letters, digits and underscores only
章節（可直接輸入新名稱）: Chapter (type to create a new one)
修改英文 ID 會更新專案內的 call；手寫 .rpy 的引用請同步修改。: Changing an ID updates project references. Update references in handwritten .rpy files yourself.
章節按名稱分組。可多選段落複製、刪除、合併或移至其他章節；按「套用」才會修改專案: Chapters are grouped by name. Select multiple sections to copy, delete, merge or move. Apply to update the project; changes can be undone.
合併順序依表格由上到下，保留第一段的名稱／ID 和最後一段的 call。其他段的: Merge in table order, keeping the first section's name/ID and the last ending call. References are redirected to the first section. Deletion clears ending calls to removed sections.
已新增段落；按套用儲存到專案。: Section added. Apply to save it to the project.
請先選取要變更章節的段落。: Select the sections whose chapter you want to change.
選擇章節或輸入新章節名稱: Select a chapter or enter a new name
已複製 {count} 個段落，副本使用新的永久台詞 ID。: Duplicated {count} sections with new dialogue IDs.
已刪除 {count} 個段落，清除 {refs} 個 call 引用。尚未套用: Deleted {count} sections and cleared {refs} ending calls. Not applied yet; you can cancel.
已合併 {count} 個段落，保留既有台詞 ID；手寫 label 引用請同步: Merged {count} sections, retaining dialogue IDs. Update handwritten label references yourself.
圖片標籤，例如 bg classroom；選項類型時可輸入提問文字: Image tag, e.g. bg classroom; for choices, enter a prompt
分支直接使用既有段落；可先到「章節／段落管理」新增分支。背景圖片匯入後會跟隨專案: Branches use existing sections; create them in Chapters / Sections first. Imported images are stored with the project.
ID 必須是英文字母或底線開頭，且只能包含英數字與底線。: IDs must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
圖片標籤只可使用英數字、底線及空格: Image tags may contain only letters, digits, underscores and spaces.
選單至少需要一個選項: A menu needs at least one choice.
匯出圖片需要專案位置: Save the project before exporting images.
匯出字體需要已儲存的專案位置: Save the project before exporting fonts.
匯出含素材的 Excel 需要專案位置: Save the project before exporting Excel with assets.
Excel 欄位不符合範本: Excel columns do not match the template.
Excel 沒有台詞: The Excel file contains no dialogue.
找不到專案字體，請還原素材資料夾：: Missing project font. Restore the assets folder:
請選擇 TTF 或 OTF 字體。: Choose a TTF or OTF font.
無法讀取字體，請選擇有效的 TTF 或 OTF 檔案。: Cannot read this font. Choose a valid TTF or OTF file.
請選擇有效的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 圖片。: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
請填寫章節名稱與段落名稱。: Enter the chapter and section names.
專案至少要保留一個段落。: The project must keep at least one section.
請選取至少兩個段落進行合併。: Select at least two sections to merge.
合併後會呼叫自身，請先移除最後段落的內部 call。: Merging would create a self-call. Remove the last section's internal call first.
「{name}」有不能直接合併的 call，請先調整流程；只允許呼叫下一個待合併: Section "{name}" has an incompatible call. Only a call to the next selected section can be merged.
依章節與段落整理的台詞稿，包含角色、台詞、備註及流程提示，供閱讀與校對使用。: A script arranged by chapter and section, including characters, dialogue, notes and flow cues for review.
輸入顯示在文件首頁的標題: Enter the title shown on the first page
Label 前綴只能使用英文字母、數字與底線，且不可用數字開頭；可留空。: Label prefixes must use ASCII letters, numbers and underscores, and cannot start with a number. Leave blank for no prefix.
NVL 會在同一頁累積多段文字，請在適當位置插入「NVL 清頁」。: NVL keeps multiple paragraphs on a page. Insert “Clear NVL page” where a new page should begin.
NVL 模式下，nvl 與 nvl_narrator 是保留角色代號。: The character IDs nvl and nvl_narrator are reserved when using NVL mode.
NVL 清頁指令不應包含角色或台詞。: An NVL page-clear command must not contain a character or dialogue.
NVL 選項設定必須為開關值。: NVL choice settings must be boolean values.
也可以按 Enter 到下一行，Tab / Shift+Tab 左右切換欄位。: Enter: next row · Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous cell.
依目前語言開啟全新示例副本，可自由修改；修改後會出現在最近專案。: Open a fresh example copy in the selected language. Edit freely; reopen your copy from recent projects.
匯出資料夾必須位於 Ren’Py game 資料夾內。: The export folder must be inside the Ren’Py game folder.
尚未開啟過專案。可以新建專案，或從下方 Sample 開始。: No recent projects yet. Create a project or start with a Sample below.
找不到專案，可能已移動或刪除。: Project not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
直接儲存在所選資料夾: Save directly in the selected folder
請輸入有效的子資料夾名稱，且不要包含斜線或特殊路徑字元。: Enter a valid subfolder name without slashes or special path characters.
輸出 characters.rpy、dialogue.rpy 及所需素材。使用: Exports characters.rpy, dialogue.rpy and required assets. For Ren’Py, choose the game folder or a folder inside it.
這個資料夾已有同名專案，請開啟原專案或選擇另一個資料夾。: This folder already contains a project with that name. Open it or choose another folder.
選擇新專案資料夾（可建立新資料夾）: Choose a project folder (you can create one)
預設 adv_；可改成 story_ 或留空。專案內的 call、jump、選項: Defaults to adv_; change it to story_ or leave blank. Internal calls, jumps and choices update together. Update references in handwritten .rpy files separately.
